source_title: Yash takes a break from 'Ramayana' promos for Disneyland date with kids
source_excerpt: Actor Yash has been keeping busy promoting his upcoming epic 'Ramayana' in Los Angeles. The star, who has been running on a tight schedule filming, producing and promoting his films, took a break to spend a day out with his children, who had accompanied him to the 'Ramayana' premiere.During a recent early-morning news channel appearance to promote the film, the actor revealed that he was looking forward to his day out with his children. In a behind-the-scenes video from the cast's promotional activities, the actors were asked about the places they were most excited to visit while in LA. While Ranbir Kapoor spoke about enjoying the opportunity to promote the film, interact with local media outlets and see families' reactions to the film, Sai Pallavi had a different destination in mind, quipping that she was looking forward to visiting Century City Mall.Yash, on the other hand, said, "I'm going to Disneyland with my kids. LA first time, but I have been to Orlando."Ranbir was quick to share his own enthusiasm for the city's theme parks, adding, "For me also, Disneyland and Universal Studios."The cast also expressed an interest in visiting the Broad Museum and the iconic Chinese Theatre during their time in Los Angeles.Following their appearance on the American morning news programme, Ranbir reflected on the experience, describing it as a 'surreal' moment in his career. The actor revealed, "First time being on an American early morning news chanel, its quite surreal. I've always been watching so much American television. I was studying in New York, but to do this in the studio was quite humbling and amazing."Ranbir also revealed that Yash had been keeping a close eye on the weather forecast, as he was jittery about taking his children out. A relieved Yash admitted, "Yeah! I got the weather report here."The cast is in their final leg of promotions with 'Ramayana: Rise of a Legend' set to release on November 5, with special screenings and early previews reportedly set for November 4.Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, 'Ramayana' also stars Sunny Deol as Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshmana, among many others.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
